summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Seres Therapeutics under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose top-line clinical trial results for SER-155 in irEC patients and an updated corporate presentation. The filing does not involve any special-situation corporate transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. It is a standard disclosure of clinical data and does not meet any special-situations classification.
